result.instructions: Tools for Northflank, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a service from my connected GitHub repository with a Dockerfile, HTTP health check and inherited environment secrets."; "List my services and show which ones are paused."; "Show how much processor power and memory the worker service used in the last hour.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Northflank data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run northflank_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run northflank_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run northflank_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. northflank_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: northflank_list_repositories
tools.title: List connected GitHub repositories
tools.description: List GitHub repositories accessible through Northflank's linked GitHub accounts, with repository URLs and account logins for northflank_create_combined_service. Does not connect a new GitHub account. GET /v1/integrations/vcs/repos.

teamId.description: Team id, required for an organization-scoped token.

accountLogin.description: Filter by the linked GitHub account login.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's pagination.cursor to fetch the next page.

tools.name: northflank_list_plans
tools.title: List deployment plans
tools.description: List Northflank deployment plan IDs, CPU, RAM and vendor prices. Choose an explicit deploymentPlan for northflank_create_combined_service; these are Northflank infrastructure charges, separate from UsefulAPI. GET /v1/plans.

tools.name: northflank_create_combined_service
tools.title: Create GitHub build and deployment service (incurs charges)
tools.description: MUTATING: create a combined service that builds a connected GitHub repository and deploys it. May incur Northflank build/compute charges and expose the selected HTTP port publicly. Confirm the repository, branch, plan, port and inherited-secret access with the user, then pass confirm=true. Supply absolute Dockerfile/context paths. environmentSecretReferences maps runtime variable names to existing inherited variable NAMES (for example DATABASE_URL: DB_CONNECTION becomes ${DB_CONNECTION}); never supply secret values. Secret groups must already apply to this service through project scope, existing tags or stageId. This tool does not change secret-group restrictions. A successful creation is not proof of a successful build or healthy deployment: inspect the service and build history. Never blindly retry an uncertain creation; list services first. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/combined.

teamId.description: Team id, required for an organization-scoped token.

repositoryUrl.description: HTTPS GitHub repository URL from northflank_list_repositories, without a trailing slash, query or credentials.

accountLogin.description: Linked GitHub account login from northflank_list_repositories; useful when multiple accounts are linked.

dockerfilePath.description: Absolute repository path to the Dockerfile, e.g. /Dockerfile or /apps/api/Dockerfile.

dockerWorkDir.description: Absolute repository build context; defaults to /.

deploymentPlan.description: Explicit deployment plan ID from northflank_list_plans; charged by Northflank.

buildPlan.description: Optional Northflank build plan ID; omitted uses the vendor default.

instances.description: Initial running replicas, charged by Northflank.

httpPort.description: Container HTTP listen port. The application must listen on 0.0.0.0.

public.description: Explicitly choose whether the HTTP port is publicly accessible.

healthCheck.description: Optional HTTP health check on the container's HTTP port.

path.description: HTTP health endpoint on httpPort, e.g. /health.

environmentSecretReferences.description: Runtime variable name -> existing inherited variable name; values are NAMES, never credentials. Source variables must already be inherited from applicable runtime secret groups. Avoid mapping a name to itself: inherited variables already exist.

tags.description: Previously defined resource tags, including any tags required to inherit the intended secret groups.

stageId.description: Existing project environment/stage id for stage-scoped secret inheritance.

confirm.description: Required: user approved creating the service, its charges, public exposure and inherited-secret access.

tools.name: northflank_get_service_metrics
tools.title: Get service metrics
tools.description: Get CPU / memory metrics for a service's containers. GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/{serviceId}/metrics. Use queryType=single (default) for a current snapshot or queryType=range with duration/startTime/endTime.

metricTypes.description: Which metrics to return; defaults to all if omitted.

duration.description: Range duration in seconds (alternative to startTime/endTime).

tools.name: northflank_trigger_service_build
tools.title: Trigger service build (mutates infra)
tools.description: MUTATING: start a new build for a build/combined service. With an empty body it builds the latest commit on the linked branch; optionally target a branch, a specific commit sha, or a pull request. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/{serviceId}/build.

branch.description: Branch to build (defaults to the service's linked branch).

sha.description: Specific commit SHA to build from the branch.

pullRequestId.description: Build the latest commit of this pull request's branch.

tools.name: northflank_restart_service
tools.title: Restart service (mutates infra)
tools.description: MUTATING: restart all running containers of a service. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/{serviceId}/restart.

tools.name: northflank_scale_service
tools.title: Scale service (mutates infra)
tools.description: MUTATING: set the number of running instances (replicas) for a service. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/{serviceId}/scale.

tools.name: northflank_pause_service
tools.title: Pause service (mutates infra)
tools.description: MUTATING: pause a service, scaling it to zero running instances. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/{serviceId}/pause.

tools.name: northflank_resume_service
tools.title: Resume service (mutates infra)
tools.description: MUTATING: resume a paused service. Optionally set the instance count and CI/CD/autoscaling state to restore. POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/services/{serviceId}/resume.

instances.description: Instances to scale to on resume.

disabledCI.description: Whether CI should be disabled after resume.

disabledCD.description: Whether CD should be disabled after resume.

enableAutoscaling.description: Restore autoscaling (defaults to the state captured when paused).
